mapper.select: select attach_no from sale_thumbnail where sale_no = #{saleNo}
mapper.update: update sale set sale_name = #{saleName}, sale_category = #{saleCategory}, sale_original_price = #{saleOriginalPrice}, sale_discount_price = #{saleDiscountPrice}, sale_content = #{saleContent}, sale_stock = #{saleStock} where sale_no = #{saleNo}
mapper.select: select S.sale_no, S.sale_name, S.sale_category, S.sale_original_price, S.sale_discount_price, T.attach_no from sale S left outer join sale_thumbnail T on S.sale_no = T.sale_no where S.sale_no = #{saleNo}
